keyMaterial: Mock keyId/fixtureRef/validity descriptors only; no private/public cryptographic key generation

identity.enrollment: Volatile pairing nonce/boot/TTL plus admin authorization and subject-possession fixture

keys.rotation: Explicit STAGE then ACTIVATE with readiness ACK from every current receiver in immutable scope
keys.revocation: Terminal; active-key revocation cancels staging and permits no fallback
keys.reuse: Key IDs and fixture references are never reused within a registry, including cancelled/retired/revoked entries

auth73.policyChange: Explicit new generation; old policy/logs are never rewritten
auth73.securityEpoch: Enrollment/activation/revocation advance epoch; staging/cancel do not silently activate
auth73.replayFrontier: Registry keeps sequence and used challenge nonce per source principal/receiver/direction across key changes
auth73.commitOrder: Validate claim, reserve registry frontier and anchor, then AUTH73 side effect
auth73.reserveGap: Consumed frontier cannot be retried; explicit fresh nonce/higher sequence after recovery
auth73.historicalReceipt: Preserved bytes and proof consistency, never interpreted as current authentication after epoch/key changes

storage.anchor: Separate same-host mock frontier; mismatch HOLD without repair

notChecked: root CA rollover and all-keys-lost recovery
real trusted clock/external anchor/joint rollback protection
